_comment: Labelled commit eval for the seven agents (+ reviewer). Each case is applied to origin/main as one commit and pushed to its own branch; the production pipeline assesses it like any push. kind: idor = the ownership check template can prove it end to end; vuln = a real weakness outside the current check templates (scored on detection only); benign = no weakness (any validated finding or fix is a false positive). Commit messages are ordinary and never name the defect. Do not add cases that put secrets in the tree.
